meta.description: Animated wallpapers for Windows and Linux, built to use little. In development.

hero.title: What you see when you move the windows aside
hero.text: {{brand}} puts animated wallpapers behind your windows, on Windows and Linux. It's built to use little.
hero.status: In development. There's no version to download yet.

app.hint: This page's background is a live wallpaper. These controls change it.
app.noGl: Your browser doesn't have WebGL turned on, so the wallpaper shows as a still image. This isn't an error.
app.reduced: Your system asks for reduced motion, so the wallpaper stays still. Colors and brightness still change.

why.title: Why {{brand}}
why.pause: When you play full screen, run on battery or lock the screen.
why.linux: Native Wayland on KDE, Hyprland and Sway.
why.monitors: Or the same one on all of them, your choice.

monitors.title: A different wallpaper on every screen
monitors.text: Pick a screen and change its wallpaper. The others keep theirs. The names are the ones your system uses.

stage.title: Where it stands
stage.dev: The foundation is being built. There's no version to download yet.
stage.first: Image and video wallpapers on Windows and Linux, with automatic pauses.
stage.later: More Linux desktops, wallpapers generated in real time, and web wallpapers.

oss.title: Open source
oss.text: The code is public under the AGPL‑3.0 license, with an exception so it can be published on Steam.

footer.privacy: This page uses no cookies or analytics.
